This mod changes the chickens to match my sheep.
White-Scarf
Brown-Bowtie

Suggestions or ideas or requests are always welcome.

FUTURE
I plan to continue to make new versions of everything for the farm so they match.
Currently ill be making the farm animals, so any ideas for them are welcome.
